_comment: The policy discovery runs under. Declared here as reviewable data, not
assembled from CLI flags at invocation time: an allowlist a caller can
extend is not an allowlist. --allow-path may only NARROW this set, and
the narrowing is validated with the same predicate tenant overlays use.
allowed_paths covers the login page, the frameset shell, the nav frame,
and the member servicing flow. /_faults is deliberately absent: the agent
must not be able to change the application's own fault state, which is the
smallest honest demonstration that this list constrains something real.
allowed_actions is the full artifact vocabulary because discovery does not
know in advance which actions a goal will need. The recorder narrows the
emitted artifact to the actions actually used.
